# The corpus Oak's own analyzers are run over, for froe to replay.
#
# One input per line. A `#` line is a comment and an empty line is
# skipped, so every escape below exists to keep a control character,
# an astral character or a ten-thousand-token text out of the file:
#
#   \n \t \r \\   the obvious four
#   \uNNNN         one UTF-16 code unit
#   \xNNNNNN       one code point, so an astral character is one escape
#   \*N*TEXT*      TEXT repeated N times
#
# The judge unescapes, analyzes, and prints the tuples; froe replays
# them. What each line is for is in the comment above it.
# plain ASCII words
the quick brown fox
# case transitions, which Oak does not split on
PowerShot iPhone XMLHttpRequest
# a hyphen, which the tokenizer breaks at
Foo-Bar well-known e-mail
# underscores, which are ExtendNumLet and join
foo_bar _leading trailing_
# an apostrophe and a possessive
O'Neil's Bar's don't
# a right single quotation mark as the apostrophe
O\u2019Neil\u2019s
# digits inside words, which Oak does not split on
j2se utf8 x86_64 3rd
# bare numbers and number groupings
42 3.14 1,000 1_000
# a mixed string the specification works through
Foo-Bar's 3rd j2se PowerShot
# CJK ideographs, one token each
\u4e2d\u6587\u6d4b\u8bd5
# hiragana, one token each, and katakana, run together
\u3072\u3089\u304c\u306a \u30ab\u30bf\u30ab\u30ca
# hangul, run together
\ud55c\uad6d\uc5b4
# Thai, a complex-context run
\u0e44\u0e17\u0e22
# a combining mark, which Extend attaches to its base
cafe\u0301 a\u0300b
# an emoji, which is not a word character
hello \x01f600 world
# two regional indicators, consumed and not emitted
\x01f1e6\x01f1e7 flag
# an astral letter, which the supplementary macros cover
\x010400\x010401 deseret
# whitespace variants
a\tb\u00a0c\u2003d
# a newline, which only the suggest chain splits on
first\nsecond\nthird
# a repository path, which the ancestors chain walks
/content/interop/page
# a deeper path
/content/dam/collections/a/b/c
# a path with a trailing element only
/content
# the root, whose parent path is itself
/
# a token of exactly 255 code units, which survives
\*255*a*
# a token of 256 code units, which the standard tokenizer drops
\*256*b*
# 254 units then an astral character, so the token reaches 256
\*254*c*\x010400
# a suggest line of 255 units, at the character tokenizer bound
\*255*d*
# a suggest line of 300 units, which that tokenizer cuts
\*300*e*
# a text above the ten-thousand-token cap
\*10050*f *
# an empty-ish input of separators alone
--- ... !!!
# a Hebrew letter with a single quote, UAX#29 WB7a
\u05d0\u05d1\u0027
# a Hebrew letter with a double quote between letters, WB7b
\u05d0\u0022\u05d1
# a number joined to a letter run by a mid-num-let
3.5kg 1,5m
# a format character inside a word, which WB4 absorbs
ab\u200dcd
# an over-long token followed by a short one: the dropped token still
# takes a position, so the next token's increment is 2
\*256*b* tail
# an over-long token between two short ones, which the shingle chain
# fills with its filler token
alpha \*300*z* beta gamma
